resources.string: Here are the changes in this version. Your settings are preserved.
Full-width hub button with light text and separate text size and vertical padding controls.
Magenta indicator: fixed, slowly pulsing or off. Visible only with notifications; disabled system animations are respected.
Settings reorganized into Home, Clock and indicators, Notifications and hub, Widgets, Appearance and About. Existing preferences are preserved.
Battery icon to the right of its percentage in the standard layout. Licenses available in About.
